description: A script for safely cleaning Next.js cache directories (.next and node_modules/.cache) by removing them with retries, and ensuring certain directories exist to prevent startup errors.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs a message to stdout followed by a newline.

methods.name: sleepSync
methods.description: Implements a busy wait for the specified milliseconds.

methods.name: rmDirIfExists
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists and if so, attempts to remove it recursively with retries.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Ensures that a directory exists, creating it recursively if necessary.
